products.name: The Rawalpindi Sideboard
products.tagline: Storage for the good china and the everyday plates.
products.description: Four soft-close doors behind a fluted front, with an adjustable shelf in each bay. The flutes are cut on the router but cleaned up by hand, one at a time.

products.name: The Cherat Nightstand
products.tagline: One drawer, one shelf, no clutter.
products.description: A small bedside table with a dovetailed drawer that slides on waxed runners and closes with the quiet click of solid wood against solid wood.

products.name: The Attok Three-Seat Sofa
products.tagline: Room for three, comfort for all.
products.description: A straight-backed three-seater on exposed hardwood legs, sprung with elastic webbing and filled with high-resilience foam over a feather topper.

products.name: The Safari Console Table
products.tagline: Slim enough for a hallway, handsome enough for anywhere.
products.description: A narrow console with a drawer for keys and a lower shelf for shoes that never quite made it upstairs. The top is a single board.

products.name: The Shahrah Dining Chair
products.tagline: Sold in pairs, built for decades.
products.description: A spindle-back chair steam-bent for a gentle recline. The joints are wedged, not glued — tighten a wedge, add a decade.

products.name: The Kohsar Coffee Table Set
products.tagline: One large table, two nesting companions.
products.description: A trio of tables that tuck under one another when the room needs its floor back. Turned legs, rounded corners, honest grain.

products.name: Commission a Bespoke Piece
products.tagline: Your drawing, our workshop, one heirloom.
products.description: Bring a sketch, a photograph, or just an idea. We measure the room, choose the timber with you, and draw the piece full-size before a single cut is made. Most commissions take between six and twelve weeks.

products.name: The Heirloom Dresser
products.description: A wide dresser with hand-cut dovetails in every drawer and a mirror framed in the same board that forms its top.
